capabilities.domain_role: consume scoped parent/global requirements while owning normal domain business requirements and execution; return business evidence without transferring domain ownership

use parent guidance to turn user outcomes and functional expectations into a complete domain product definition covering requirements, non-goals, workflow/state, failure/recovery, assurance, acceptance/evals and ownership boundaries; persist the resulting domain product authority in the domain repository
rules: Use this capability for a new domain product, major rebuild, material feature family, or when failures expose missing/incorrect product requirements or architecture.
Start from user outcomes and observed functions; fill missing requirement details before choosing implementation structure.

Define functional requirements, non-functional constraints, state/workflow, failure and recovery semantics, evidence/assurance, acceptance criteria, non-goals and authority ownership before calling the product architecture complete.
UAOS may challenge scope, assumptions and topology and may supply reusable product-engineering method, but domain-specific requirements and architecture remain owned by the domain repository.
Product review must create traceable acceptance/eval targets rather than documentation-only confidence.

capabilities.domain_role: allow one selected domain Agent to decompose business work into independently owned subtasks/workstreams with explicit dependency, concurrency, consultation, competition, revision, synthesis and adjudication relations while the domain remains the single user-facing business owner
rules: The domain owns its internal work graph, workstream identities, project/program identities, decision receipts and business state. UAOS must not mirror these as parent task identities or become the domain micro-scheduler.
Subtasks may run concurrently when their declared inputs and dependencies are satisfied; unrelated unfinished work must not block them merely because it belongs to an earlier global wave.
A downstream task depends only on declared dependencies plus required artifact inputs. Dependency edges must be acyclic and mechanically inspectable.
Consultation produces advisory evidence; it does not silently transfer decision authority.
Competition uses independently produced candidates and declared evaluation criteria. Same-context candidate generation is diversity evidence, not independent verification.
Negotiation or deliberation must be represented as structured artifact rounds such as proposal -> critique -> revision -> adjudication rather than unbounded peer chat.
A decision that selects, merges or rejects competing candidates must identify the authorized adjudicator/owner and emit a durable decision result before dependent work proceeds.
Specialists are split only when their tools, policy, context or output contract materially differ; do not multiply agents for cosmetic role-play.
Internal orchestration must preserve least-context execution, explicit artifact handoffs, producer/reviewer separation where required, and current domain recovery/evolution rules.

capabilities.domain_role: expose current domain business authority, checkpoints, cursors and artifact identities; direct child sessions do not require a live parent proxy
declare domain capability ceiling and action-specific requirements; current host proves executability
produce domain verification evidence without overstating assurance
own normal domain execution while accepting parent governance and using parent upcalls for system-level guidance
rules: Same-owner mutation remains allowed under normal owner controls.
UAOS may govern a registered descendant when ancestry and governance_basis are explicit and domain authority/impact/verification are respected.
A child/domain cannot directly mutate UAOS or a sibling domain.
A registered child may be activated directly as the current Agent/work plane in a fresh chat; parent authority does not imply a mandatory per-turn business gateway.
A child may call parent guidance without transferring the selected business task, business identity, workflow or state.
Approval cannot override hierarchy.

capabilities.domain_role: before external/durable mutation, surface target/authority and follow the owner-appropriate autonomous maintenance path without surrendering business ownership
rules: The lightweight mutation sentinel is always-on; problem-response cognition is mandatory when a problem is detected.
Normal material GitHub maintenance uses candidate isolation, owner-appropriate checks, controlled merge/update and production reread.
Rulesets or protected branches are optional defense-in-depth for the baseline and are required only when physical non-bypassability is explicitly required or claimed.
CAS is concurrency control, not authorization or evidence of physical non-bypassability.
UAOS governs the shared maintenance property but does not duplicate a child's CI, release semantics or business validation.
Custom Instructions may bootstrap the sentinel across chats but are not physical enforcement.

capabilities.domain_role: bind to the current canonical UAOS cognition owner, expose owner-native evidence for the selected risk-adaptive search mode, and request parent guidance when common/cross-domain diagnosis, replanning or architecture support is useful
rules: Problem detection is always-on after authority selection, but deliberation depth is selected by the canonical DELIBERATION_POLICY rather than by a child-local fixed research floor.
LIGHTWEIGHT local/familiar problems do not require ceremonial external research when current evidence is sufficient.

CONTRASTIVE corrections/change proposals compare competing hypotheses and actions; STRUCTURED systemic/material/high-risk/unknown cases require deeper falsification, architecture/upstream reassessment and external research.
Same-model reflection/debate is candidate generation, not independent verification.
Children may add stricter domain-specific evidence requirements when justified, but must not weaken or freeze a competing copy of the parent cognition algorithm.
Do not create a parallel architecture-advisor or debate control plane.

capabilities.lifecycle: INCIDENT_OR_CAPABILITY_GAP_OR_EVALUATED_KNOWLEDGE -> DISCOVERY/EVIDENCE -> CHANGE_PROPOSAL -> REPRODUCIBLE_EVALUATION -> OWNER_SCOPED_AUTHORIZATION -> GOVERNED_PROMOTION -> POST_PROMOTION_OBSERVATION -> KEEP/ROLLBACK/RETIRE
capabilities.domain_role: turn domain problems, user feedback, proactively discovered capability gaps and sufficiently mature knowledge into evidence-bound evolution transactions; evaluate generalization and alternatives; promote only owner-scoped changes with regression/eval evidence; and upcall common/cross-domain evolution to UAOS
rules: Every detected problem receives an explicit learning/evolution disposition after canonical risk-adaptive cognition; not every problem becomes a durable global rule or release.
A proactively discovered latent capability gap may originate evolution without fabricating an incident, but must be traceable to admitted outside-in discovery and raw evidence.
Evaluated/canonical knowledge may originate evolution without fabricating an incident, but it uses the same transaction, evaluation, complexity, promotion and observation gates.
Incident, capability-gap and evaluated-knowledge origins converge on one canonical EvolutionTransaction; helper-local lifecycle fragments are not independent transaction owners.

Material/proactive evolution preserves governing outcome, raw evidence, professional method/tool evidence and an external/independent judge; proactive capability-gap evolution also includes novelty/unknown-signal probes.
Stretch targets are bounded search constraints and require feasibility evidence; repeating an ambitious target to the model is not proof that it is achievable.
Domain-local learning is evidence/candidate generation, not a second controller or unrestricted production rewriter.
One article, one feedback event, one source or one discovery lens may create a candidate but must not silently become a universal rule.
Cross-domain/common-capability changes are promoted by UAOS; domain-specific business rules remain domain-owned under UAOS lineage.
Triggered material evolution must expose a durable transaction/evaluation record at the owning scope.
Evolution closure requires an authority-wide contradiction scan across the surfaces that can encode the changed semantic; edited-file success alone is not closure.
Promotion is not closure. Post-promotion observation determines keep, rollback or retirement.

capabilities.domain_role: supply fresh current_stage, next_action/blocker, authority context, evolution/deliberation state and business update/version data
expose stable version/hash/schema identities and ISO-8601 update timestamps for material authority

anti_duplication: Do not copy UAOS cross-domain task indexes, parent-continuation protocols, global requirement registries, evolution catalogs or promotion state into domain repositories.
Do not mirror child project/program/workstream/subtask identities into UAOS parent task state; parent routing may retain only opaque child references when continuity requires them.
Do not turn UAOS into a mandatory per-turn business proxy merely because a domain inherits common capabilities.
Do not create a parallel parent-guidance, architecture-advisor, self-dialogue or verification control plane when existing Control/Context/Assurance/Evolution contracts can be extended.

Do not create a second evolution state machine beside config/EVOLUTION_POLICY.json and EvolutionTransaction; domain-specific learning hooks remain owner-native mechanisms under the common transaction contract.
Do not duplicate a child repository's business-specific CI/release logic merely to satisfy common mutation discipline; reuse owner-declared checks where available.

A domain may implement business-specific learning/evaluation hooks and internal task orchestration, but those remain domain business mechanisms under the common governance contract rather than replacement parent controllers.
